name: Hersheys syrup indulgent caramel flavor
ingredients_raw: CORN SYRUP, HIGH FRUCTOSE CORN SYRUP, WATER, SUGAR, SKIMMED MILK POWDER, ACIDITY REGULATOR (DISODIUM PHOSPHATE (E339(ii))), NATURAL COLOUR (CARAMEL (E150A)); ACIDITY REGULATOR (SODIUM CITRATE (E331)), ARTIFICIAL FLAVOUR (CARAMEL), SALT, PRESERVATIVE (POTASSIUM SORBATE (E202)), EMULSIFIER (CITRIC ACID ESTER (E472C)), THICKENING AGENT (XANTHAN GUM (E415)).
